measures.name: active_subscribers
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source.activity_level IN ('Partially Active', 'Minimally Active', 'Fully Active') THEN source.UserID END)

measures.name: inactive_subscribers
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source.activity_level = 'Inactive Subscriber' THEN source.UserID END)

frame.description:

**Recommendation**: Target underrepresented segments through tailored acquisition campaigns.
frame.title: Total Subscribers

frame.description:
**Insight**: 10,000 total viewing sessions indicate strong platform engagement.

**Recommendation**: Increase session frequency through personalized content recommendations.
frame.title: Total Viewing Sessions

frame.description:
**Insight**: 91K total watch minutes demonstrates platform stickiness.

**Recommendation**: Set quarterly watch time growth targets and track progression towards 150K minutes.
frame.title: Total Watch Minutes

frame.description:
**Insight**: Average session duration suggests short-form content consumption patterns.

**Recommendation**: Optimize content length and introduce binge-worthy series to increase watch time.

**Insight**: 5,441 active subscribers (Fully, Partially, Minimally active combined) represent 85% engagement rate.

**Recommendation**: Set goal to move 50% of minimally active users to partially/fully active via gamification.
frame.title: Active Subscribers

frame.description:
**Insight**: 598 inactive subscribers (15% churn risk) require immediate intervention.

**Recommendation**: Launch 30-day win-back campaign with exclusive content and personalized offers.
frame.title: Inactive Subscribers

frame.description:
**Insight**: 18 active channels provide content variety.

**Recommendation**: Evaluate bottom performers for replacement or repositioning; negotiate sports content expansion.
frame.title: Number of TV Channels

lines:
## Viewer Demographics

**Understanding our subscriber base composition**

frame.description:
**Insight**: Youth segment dominates (55%), followed by middle adults (34%).

**Recommendation**: Develop age-appropriate content strategies for pensioners and children segments.
frame.title: Subscribers by Age Group

frame.description:
**Insight**: Black subscribers lead at 38%, followed by Indian/Asian (17%) and White (17%); diverse representation achieved.

**Recommendation**: Ensure content library reflects this diversity and expand culturally relevant programming.
frame.title: Subscribers by Race

frame.description:
**Insight**: Gauteng dominates with 37% of subscribers, Western Cape (18%) and Kwazulu Natal (10%) follow.

**Recommendation**: Focus expansion efforts on underserved provinces like Northern Cape and Free State.
frame.title: Subscribers by Province

frame.description:
**Insight**: Strong male skew (85%) indicates gender imbalance in subscriber base.

**Recommendation**: Launch targeted campaigns to attract female viewers and balance content offerings.
frame.title: Subscribers by Gender

lines:
## Viewer Behaviour

**Analyzing viewing patterns by time and engagement level**

frame.description:
**Insight**: Peak viewing hours are 12 PM-8 PM, with lowest activity 2-5 AM.

**Recommendation**: Schedule premium content during peak hours and optimize ad inventory placement for maximum reach.
frame.title: Viewing Sessions by Hour

frame.description:
**Insight**: Friday and Saturday lead with 1,675 and 1,633 sessions; Monday shows lowest engagement.

**Recommendation**: Launch new content on Thursdays to capture weekend momentum and run re-engagement campaigns on Mondays.
frame.title: Viewing Sessions by Day

frame.description:
**Insight**: 60% of sessions are short (<5 min), indicating snacking behavior; 860 no-watch sessions signal abandoned sessions.

**Recommendation**: Improve content discovery and reduce friction in the first 30 seconds to convert short sessions into longer engagement.
frame.title: Sessions by Duration Bucket

frame.description:
**Insight**: 3,200 minimally active subscribers represent untapped potential; 598 inactive subscribers at risk of churn.

**Recommendation**: Implement tiered engagement campaigns to move minimally active users to partially/fully active and win back inactive subscribers.
frame.title: Subscribers by Activity Level

lines:
## Channel Performance

**Analyzing viewership across TV channels**

frame.description:
**Insight**: ICC Cricket leads with 24.7K minutes, followed by Live Sport Events (18.8K) - sports dominates viewership.

**Recommendation**: Invest in more sports content rights and partnerships to capitalize on proven audience preference.
frame.title: Top 10 Channels by Watch Minutes

frame.description:
**Insight**: Top 5 channels account for 67% of total watch time; long tail underperforms.

**Recommendation**: Bundle underperforming channels into themed packages to improve discoverability.
frame.title: Channel Performance Summary

frame.description:
**Insight**: 100% email opt-in rate presents strong marketing opportunity.

**Recommendation**: Leverage email for personalized content recommendations, re-engagement, and retention campaigns.
frame.title: Email Engagement

frame.description:
**Insight**: 96% have social media handles, enabling social listening and influencer partnerships.

**Recommendation**: Build social community, track sentiment, and launch viral campaigns to drive acquisition.
frame.title: Social Media Presence

lines:
## Retention & Growth Opportunities

**Identifying at-risk segments and underperforming channels**

frame.description:
**Insight**: Gauteng has 210 inactive subscribers (35% of total inactive), proportional to subscriber base.

**Recommendation**: Target high-value segments in Gauteng with hyper-personalized win-back offers.
frame.title: Inactive Subscribers by Province

frame.description:
**Insight**: Youth segment contributes 55% of inactive subscribers despite being most engaged overall.

**Recommendation**: Refresh content library for youth with trending shows and interactive features.
frame.title: Inactive Subscribers by Age Group

lines:
## Geographic Analysis

**Regional performance and distribution insights**

frame.description:
**Insight**: Gauteng contributes 32K watch minutes (36% of total), showing strong engagement aligned with subscriber base.

**Recommendation**: Replicate Gauteng's success model in other high-population provinces.
frame.title: Watch Minutes by Province

frame.description:
**Insight**: Activity patterns are consistent across provinces; minimal regional targeting needed.

**Recommendation**: Apply universal engagement strategies rather than province-specific campaigns.
frame.title: Activity Distribution by Province
